_doc: Recovery-challenge sealing shared by the server (crates/atlas-server/src/auth/recovery.rs) and the client's unsealKey (packages/client-core/src/crypto/asym.ts). GET /auth/recovery-keys seals a 32-byte nonce to the account's X25519 public key: shared = X25519(ephemeral_secret_key, recipient_public_key); aes_key = HKDF-SHA256(ikm = shared, no salt, info = 'atlas-seal-v1', 32 bytes); encryptedKey = AES-256-GCM(aes_key, iv, nonce, no AAD). Hex fields are lowercase; iv/ct in 'sealed' are standard padded base64 (ct = ciphertext || 16-byte tag). The client answers POST /auth/recover with challenge_response = lowercase hex of the unsealed nonce. Vector 1 uses the RFC 7748 section 6.1 key pairs (recipient = Alice, ephemeral = Bob).
